QuestInfo.name: Protecting Tylus
QuestInfo.1: #p2020008# said he heard the news from #p2081100#, and accepted my protection. I have to protect#k #p2020008##k and receive #b#t4031495##k. Let's go see #b#p2020008##k again after successfully protecting Tylus. \n\n#i4031495##t4031495# #b#c4031495# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: I successfully protected Tylus from #o8150000# and #o8140000#. Tylus taught me the Power Stance skill.

0.0: 하르모니아님께 이야기는 들었네. 크림슨 발록이 나를 납치하겠다고 그랬다더군. 예전부터 그 녀석들은 강한 자들만을 노려 공격하곤 했지. 이 타일러스 역시 그 녀석들의 공격을 많이 받아 봤어.
0.1: 크림슨 발록뿐이라면 괜찮지만 라이칸슬로프까지 함께라면 도움이 절실하겠더군. 하지만 위험한 일인데 정말 괜찮겠나? 안될 것 같으면 말하게. 다른 장로들도 있고, 정히 위험하다 싶으면 하르모니아님께서도 도와주실 테니... 정말 자네가 호위를 하겠는가?

no.0: 곤란한 모양이군. 자네 혼자서로는 어려울 테니 동료를 모아 오는 건 어떤가?

0.0: I heard from #p2081100#. #o8150000# said they are going to kidnap me. They've been attacking the strongest warriors for ages. I, #p2020008#, have been attacked many times.
0.1: If #o8150000# works with #o8140000#, I desperately need help. It's dangerous. Are you sure? If not, tell me. We have other elders. If it is really dangerous, Harmonia will help. Are you sure you can do this?

yes.0: Hurry up. I'll start soon. If you're done with your mission to protect me, I will be able to trust you. Then I'll teach you #r#q1121002##k.

no.0: You look troubled. It's tough to do this by yourself. Why don't you call some of your friends?

1.0: Thanks. I could do my mission thanks to you. No wonder why #p2081100# recommended you. In return for your efforts, I'll teach you a new skill.

yes.0: It's called Stance. You endured a risky mission. You deserve it. Hope you stand up to the threat of monsters.

item.0: When you're ready, come to me.
